en: So this project comes with 2 apps, 2 web
apps.
It's essentially a backend, the API, a REST
API, and then a frontend because I decided
to build this project in a way where we have
a single page application frontend powered
by React and not using Bun at all except for
package management that then
connects or sends requests to a backend API.
And that backend API of course is built
fully with Bun, only Bun essentially.
So let's start with the app that is not the
focus of this section, and that's the
frontend web app.
Because as mentioned, in there I'm not
really using Bun except for package
management.
I use Bun for all my package management in
this project since the course is about Bun,
of course.
But it is a standard React app. Other than
that, we're not using the Bun runtime
because the web app folder contains no
backend and the Bun runtime, of course, is
about running code on server on the backend,
not in the browser. The browser does not
have Bun built in,
and therefore in there we instead have a
regular React app. And in case you don't
know React, you can ignore that. This is not
a React course. You can just take this
frontend as granted. If you do know React,
you can of course play around with that
code, take a look at it. You'll see that I
have some routes set up here using React
Router, and you see I have some standard
React components in there. Nothing fancy in
the end.
The interesting part for this section, of
course, is the API instead.
